description: The bar chart compares the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The vertical axis represents the self-report accuracy, which is a measure of how accurately the models report their own preferences, with a scale from 0.00 to 1.00. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two groups: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, and further into three subcategories: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. Each group is represented by a set of three bars, with the Control group shown in gray, Before Introspection Training in light blue, and After Introspection Training in dark blue. The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The Control group shows a self-report accuracy of approximately 0.25 for both models, while the Before Introspection Training group shows an increase to approximately 0.50 for GPT-4o and approximately 0.75 for GPT-4o-mini. After Introspection Training, the accuracy further increases to approximately 0.75 for GPT-4o and approximately 0.90 for GPT-4o-mini. The chart includes error bars indicating the variability or uncertainty in the measurements.
